headline: Approved payments to four vendors, including $156,116.87 to Vermont Mechanical Inc.; Ends Policy and financial limitation policy discussed without votes.
summary: Members discussed the Ends Policy, a revised financial limitation policy, and a website update. They approved payments to four vendors and the consent agenda, and the Ends Policy will get a third reading at the next meeting.
decisions: Approved accounts payable checks to four vendors, from $67,580.50 to $156,116.87. All were in favor.
Approved the consent agenda, including minutes of August 12 and August 19, 2026, and payroll warrants, with no objections.

decision_evidence.quote: Seamus Abshere moved to approve A/P checks to Vermont Mechanical Inc. in the amount of $156,116.87; to Environmental Hazards Management, Inc. in the amount of $77,574.00; to Goldfield Construction Management, Inc. in the amount of $113,610.00; and to New England Floor Covering in the amount of $67,580.50... All were in favor and the motion passed.
Seamus Abshere asked if there were any objections to the minutes, Account Payables, or the Payroll Warrants. Hearing no objection, agenda was passed by consent.

decision_titles: Accounts payable checks to four vendors, $67,580.50 to $156,116.87
Consent agenda: minutes, accounts payable, and payroll warrants
